configuration.name: max_disagree_early_scale
configuration.time_sampler_note: Power-law bias toward early scales: t ~ U(0,1)^2.5, concentrating ~50% of mass on scales 0-2 (t<0.3). More relevant to one-step generation which starts from pure noise.
configuration.train_notes: Hard-example proposal selection: pick the teacher proposal with maximum LPIPS distance from the initialized student in each group. 256 samples x 4 proposals = 1024 generated, 256 selected. Uniform weighting.
